_notes: Example: Kaylee's What's News 中文版 (sentence-by-sentence Mandarin translation + AI voices of WSJ What's News), as a podcast-kit show.json.

This show needs a SOURCE ADAPTER the generic kit does not include: Caster's wn_check.py (polls the WSJ feed, downloads the edition, fetches WSJ's official transcript or falls back to faster-whisper + diarisation). The kit takes over from the translated cue script onward (render, feed, publish, verify, prune).
Episode types carry the per-edition title templates. To keep her current single combined feed, add the 'brief' type from kaylee-briefing.json to episode.types here and use one show folder.
No hosting details here: those live only in config.env.

schedule.notes: check the WSJ What's News feed regularly; publish each new A.M./P.M./weekend/bonus edition as soon as its transcript is available. DATE = the US date of the original.

sources.name: WSJ What's News podcast feed
sources.notes: the original audio and episode description

sources.name: WSJ official transcript (public video API, by RSS guid)
sources.notes: primary transcript, real speaker names; posted ~30 min to ~3.5 h after the audio

sources.name: faster-whisper + diarisation
sources.notes: fallback only when the official transcript is not yet posted; say so if a gap could not be translated

segments: Cold open: the original's teaser headlines, then [INTRO]
Host intro (今天是…我是《华尔街日报》的…这里是What's News早间版/晚间版…)
The original's segments in order; [STING] only where the original changes segment (at most 3)
format.tone: Faithful, natural spoken Mandarin (not stiff written Chinese).
rules: FAITHFUL, SENTENCE BY SENTENCE: translate every editorial sentence in order; never summarise, merge, reorder, add explanations or invent anything. Keep hedges, attributions and quotes exactly (「引用原话……引用结束」).
Proper nouns stay in English; common institutions may be glossed once (联邦贸易委员会FTC). The Wall Street Journal = 《华尔街日报》.
Declare every non-host speaker once with @speaker Name | m/f | reporter/guest/clip; unnamed voices: Voter 1, Speaker 2…; the same person keeps the same name all episode.
DROP sponsor/ad reads, newsletter promos, song lyrics/music clips, hosting boilerplate. KEEP teasers, host intro, sign-off and credits.
Prosody tag goes right after the speaker name: questions (+2%,+1Hz), sombre lines (-3%); nothing bigger.
Description must say it is an AI translation and voicing, not an official WSJ product, and link the original (pass the link as LINK to make_episode.sh).
